integrity: Exact random-update matrices, positive-definite Lyapunov identities and a reproducible symbolic checker are provided; the original algorithm and source theorem were independently reconstructed for this specialization. The review is not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the scalar quadratic, independent Bernoulli choices, fixed unit primal and dual steps, and expected squared full-state norm are covered.
Mean-square growth is not an almost-sure divergence claim, and critical mean-square boundedness does not classify individual paths.
An equivalent analysis outside the inspected literature could alter novelty priority.
title: Sharp mean-square skip-probability frontier for a scalar convex RandProx model
